findings.issue: No distributed tracing — only basic request IDs, no span propagation across API -> DB -> WebSocket -> webhook -> background jobs
findings.impact: Cannot trace a single user action across service boundaries; debugging complex failures requires manually correlating log timestamps across services with no shared trace ID
findings.fix: Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation for Express, Supabase queries, Socket.io events, and outbound HTTP calls; propagate trace context via headers

findings.issue: No automatic request logging middleware — every request log line must be manually emitted, leading to inconsistent log coverage
findings.impact: Some requests produce no access log at all; cannot audit all API calls; correlation requires manual context passing
findings.fix: Add auto-request-logging middleware that captures method, path, status code, duration, and request ID for every request before route handler

findings.issue: Request ID is not propagated to Socket.io events, background jobs, or outbound webhook calls
findings.impact: Cannot correlate WebSocket events or webhook deliveries with originating API request — making debugging of async flows impossible
findings.fix: Attach request ID to Socket.io event payloads; pass to worker tasks; include in outbound webhook X-Request-ID header

findings.issue: 18 Prometheus metrics defined but no remote collector configured — metrics sit in memory and are only accessible via unauthenticated /metrics endpoint
findings.impact: Metrics are generated but never aggregated, alerted on, or visualized; the entire metrics infrastructure has no consumer
findings.fix: Configure Prometheus remote write or set up a Grafana Cloud integration to push metrics; configure retention and alert rules

findings.issue: Push notification delivery failures logged via console.error instead of structured logger.error — no structured context, no trace ID, no error taxonomy
findings.impact: Push notification failures are invisible in centralized logging; cannot alert on failure rate or diagnose types of failures
findings.fix: Replace console.error with logger.error including structured context: notification type, user agent, endpoint, error code, request ID

findings.issue: Health checks validate only database connectivity — no Redis, Supabase Storage, or external dependency checks
findings.impact: Health check can pass 'healthy' while critical dependencies are down, giving false confidence to orchestrator
findings.fix: Add optional dependency checks for Redis (if REDIS_URL configured), Supabase Storage endpoint, and circuit breaker states

findings.issue: Audit event queue is in-memory — events lost on process restart; no Redis-backed persistence
findings.impact: Audit trail gaps during deploy windows; compliance risk for sensitive operations
findings.fix: Replace in-memory queue with Redis-backed Bull queue with persistent storage

findings.issue: Frontend has no structured logging — only console.log/error used ad-hoc with no consistent format
findings.impact: Client-side errors cannot be diagnosed from logs; no frontend telemetry for UX monitoring
findings.fix: Add frontend logging library (loglevel or pino-web) with remote log shipping; integrate with Sentry breadcrumbs

findings.issue: No worker health endpoint nor Prometheus metrics — apps/worker has zero observability instrumentation
findings.impact: Worker failures (stuck jobs, OOM, queue backlogs) are invisible until users report symptoms
findings.fix: Add health endpoint and basic metrics (jobs processed, queue depth, error rate) to apps/worker
